scope: Local router verification plus read-only inspection of the linked Supabase project's last 30 days. No provider statement reconciliation.

local_verification.command: npm test -- --maxWorkers=2 silvio aiRouterPerformance aiTurnControl aiRouterBillingVerification openrouterStream creditoEsaurito creditiSiRicaricanoSoloPagando
local_verification.isolated_node_typecheck: No test-file diagnostics; seven missing-Deno-global diagnostics in imported edge router. Not a clean whole-application typecheck.

configured_router.note: Persona or demo overrides can select another model. These are database defaults.

observed_t2_tariff_eur.warning: Tier estimates are not live model-specific provider prices; cached provider costs and retail token tariffs are separate.

historical_persona_silvio_successes.note: Includes chat, automatic briefings and other calls; not representative of the price of one chat question.

chat.note: Small historical sample, includes demo; main chat calls only, excludes classifier, embeddings, Council and nested AI. Latency is per successful router call, not end-to-end user response or time to first displayed text.

automatic_briefing.note: Historical insufficient-provider-credit errors; successful runs recorded afterward. Not evidence that the account is still blocked.

ledger_invariants.warning: No ledger or wallet records repaired. Missing linkage is not proof that no debit occurred. Historical zero-cost errors do not prove zero provider consumption.

reproduced_limitations: Router billing replay prevents a second wallet debit in the RPC simulation, but still sends a second provider request. A successful-response cache or in-flight deduplication is needed upstream to avoid that spend.

Provider cost missing plus tier lookup unavailable becomes legacy costUsd=0; the new local turn telemetry correctly marks provider_cost_complete=false. Legacy zero alone is not trustworthy proof of a free call.
Most historical chat ledger rows lack generation_id; they cannot be individually reconciled to OpenRouter from the ledger alone.
The new local performance metadata is absent from all five inspected online chat decision logs in the last seven days. Historical data is not a post-deployment benchmark of the local changes.
Request-local metering excludes embeddings, nested tool AI, background memory and delegated Council workers.
